description: Consult claude-mem before acting on a turn.
_comment_mcp: Full MCP tool names, matched exactly. Searching with a query satisfies; reading by ID or timeline without a search does not.
_comment_mcp_expect: claude-mem's MCP tools answer in prose, so only an error flag or an error pattern rejects a result.
_comment_permitted: Harness plumbing the search depends on. Claude Code defers MCP tool schemas until ToolSearch loads them; refusing it makes the search tool uncallable.
_comment_http: The worker's HTTP API, for curl and the preflight-query wrapper. Search answers GET only.
